result_revision.change_summary: Initial dev result for the released CarBench checkpoint.

methodology.record_note: Released CarBench checkpoint (carbench-weights-v1.0, transolver_plus.pth) run unchanged; every native surface point of all 1,154 official_test designs is predicted directly. Training compute is from the recorded run. Maintainer metadata correction (2026-10-22): aggregate training cost uses the stated device-count basis, and partial output-file intervals are retained only as timing context. Original predictions, evaluation command and numerical evidence are unchanged; inference was not rerun.

architecture.description: Transolver++ physics-attention transformer predicting surface pressure from per-point coordinates and outward normals.

components.description: Transolver++ physics-attention transformer predicting surface pressure from per-point coordinates and outward normals.

input_features.name: surface_coordinates
input_features.description: Native surface-point x/y/z in metres, normalized with training-set statistics.

input_features.name: surface_normals
input_features.description: Consistently auto-oriented VTK point normals of the native surface.

predicted_fields.description: Kinematic gauge pressure (m^2/s^2) at every native surface point, denormalized with training-set mean and standard deviation.

data_handling.normalization: Pressure standardized with training-split mean -94.5 and standard deviation 117.25 m^2/s^2; predictions are de-standardized before writing.
data_handling.preprocessing: Native surface read unchanged; no remeshing. Point normals from VTK compute_normals with consistency and auto-orientation.
data_handling.sampling: Training: one fixed 10,000-point random subsample of native surface points per design, preprocessed once and cached. Inference: ceil(N/10000) disjoint seeded random 10,000-point passes cover every native point once; the final pass is padded with already-predicted points for context and only new points are kept.

stages.description: Supervised training on the official DrivAerNet++ training split with model selection on the official validation split.

loss.description: Mean-squared error on standardized pressure at the sampled surface points.

duration.description: 192 epochs run; the released checkpoint is the lowest validation-loss epoch (162).

compute.measurement_notes: Recorded run transolver_plus_results_20251109_212431 (best epoch 162, batch 128): 1.38 h total training wall time. Single run with PyTorch DataParallel (multi_gpu enabled) on a 4 x A100-SXM4-80GB machine; the visible device count was not recorded and is assumed to be all four. Aggregate GPU-hours are estimated because the device count was assumed; any recorded wall time remains submitter-reported.

checkpoints.bytes_description: Raw bytes of transolver_plus.pth from the CarBench v1.0 weights release, loaded unchanged.
checkpoints.role: Exact loaded checkpoint for every prediction.
checkpoints.selection_rule: Lowest official-validation loss, selected before any test-case inference.

inference_compute.reason: Complete campaign timing is unavailable. The submitter reported 5311 seconds between the first and last prediction files for 1,154 designs, on 1 x NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB shared with other inference processes, with up to ten concurrent inference processes across two GPUs. This partial interval excludes work before the first output, including its preprocessing and prediction, and is not a complete-split wall time or an attributable GPU-time measurement. The original claim that it included all preprocessing and passes is withdrawn. Model loading and the FluidsBench evaluator were also excluded. Complete timing requires start-to-finish logs or a rerun; no new timing was measured for this metadata correction.

note: Dev result for a released CarBench checkpoint; not owner-approved and not an official result.

evaluation.command: python scripts/drivaernetplusplus.py evaluate-entry transolver_plus-entry --output work/transolver_plus --resume && python scripts/drivaernetplusplus.py package --evaluation-root work/transolver_plus/evaluation --config package-config-transolver_plus.json --discretization-cases discretization-cases.jsonl --checkpoint carbench-transolver-plus=transolver_plus.pth --output submissions/drivaernetplusplus/drivaernetplusplus-carbench-transolver-plus-dev-v1
